avoid: The Staple Singers' single spent three weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot Soul Singles chart in 1973 and became a gold record.
Mavis Staples worried that the Staple Singers' song sounded too close to their previous hit, ‘I'll Take You There’.
Their song ‘Uncloudy Day’ was an early influence on Bob Dylan, who said in 2015 that Mavis Staples's singing "just knocked me out".
Roebuck ‘Pops’ Staples worked in steel mills and meatpacking plants in Chicago while his children grew up, before the family began singing in local churches in 1948.
They performed ‘The Weight’ with The Band in the film The Last Waltz in 1976, having covered the song on their first Stax album.
Their 1984 cover of Talking Heads' ‘Slippery People’ reached the Top 5 on the Dance chart.
